2026_04_DAL_HOU.headline: Dallas’ depleted secondary faces a Texans offense searching for its passing identity
2026_04_DAL_HOU.paragraph1: Dallas reaches Houston with a battered defense: Jalen Thompson is headed for an extended absence, Jonathan Bullard is expected to miss time and several other defenders remain in recovery. That creates an opening for C.J. Stroud and a Texans offense being urged to lean more heavily on the pass, while Will Anderson Jr. gives Houston a disruptive answer against Dak Prescott. The matchup turns on whether Stroud can exploit Dallas’ replacement pieces before Anderson and the Texans front can derail Prescott’s rhythm.
2026_04_DAL_HOU.model_rationale: Dallas’ defensive attrition creates opportunities for Houston’s passing game, while the Texans’ disruptive front can pressure Prescott; whichever side better protects its quarterback owns the clearest path to control.
